messages:
anya: Quick sync — can we lock prod changelog + docs anchor for Thursday's announce? Need final URLs for post, webinar CTA, and the sales webhook.

sophie: I'll finish the changelog PR tonight and flip staging->prod tomorrow AM. Will post the exact anchor once live: /release/2026-03-26#fallbacks.

jared: Sales wants leads POSTed to https://hooks.sales.redwood.ai/announce with HMAC header. Ops, can you confirm auth is enabled?

ops-bot: ops: Auth header X-Sales-Signature configured. Scheduled deploy: canary 2026-03-26T09:50Z full 2026-03-26T10:00Z.

anya: Benchmark image for the marketing post should be CDN-prod. I uploaded: https://cdn.redwood.ai/assets/launch/bench-26mar-wide.png (alt: "Latency & cost per 1k tokens — Mar 2026").

sophie: Changelog preview for social copy: "Adaptive batching tuned for short contexts; graceful fallback to quantized-v2 under high memory pressure; streaming stability fixes." Use short form for tweet.

jared: We'll route enterprise leads (employee_count>500) to sales-enterprise, rest to nurture. Test POST sent at T-1h shows 200 OK.

anya: Perfect. Plan: announce post at 09:55 PT, webinar email at 10:00 PT. I'll post final copy in #marketing-announce 10m before. Any objections?

ops-bot: Healthcheck @ T-10m: /v1/announce/health 200 OK, 95p 40ms.

anya: :thumbsup: locking schedule.
